culprit_citations.quoted_text: Total Controlled Affiliated investments | Fair Value at December 31, 2025 | 308,845,992
Total Non-Controlled Affiliated Investments | Fair Value at December 31, 2025 | 107,862,000

findings.detail: Affiliated-investment rollforward current fair value totals of 308,845,992 and 107,862,000 were counted in addition to the schedule total, producing the 416,707,992 overage.
Non-controlled affiliated-investment rollforward fair value of 107,862,000 is duplicate disclosure, not an additional holding beyond the schedule of investments.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation shows the filing schedule total for debt and equity investments is 645,193,114, while the extracted holdings total is 1,061,901,106. The 416,707,992 overage exactly equals the affiliated-investment rollforward current fair value totals: 308,845,992 controlled plus 107,862,000 non-controlled. Those rollforward tables repeat investment fair values and should not be added to the holdings schedule. Therefore the E01 failure is a real extraction double-count error.
